$comment: Scrapbook motion data: stop-motion paper physics. Pieces are dropped, land with a small settle and get stuck down. The hand-animated feel comes from holding poses: steps() easing at 12 poses per second ('on twos' at 24 fps). Springs are kept for the settle on screens where steps would hurt usability. Timings are rules of thumb unless a source is named.
character: Hand-moved paper under a camera: things arrive in small, visible jumps, land with a little wobble, and stay put once taped. Nothing glides, and nothing moves for long.

springs.$comment: Damped spring presets. stiffness k, damping c, mass m. Used for UI and for the settle; on artwork, quantise the result with steps() (see easings.stopMotion).

drop.use: A piece landing on the page: quick, about 15% overshoot, one small rebound.

settle.use: Rotation settling to its final angle after landing (a 2-4 degree wobble).

press.use: Stamp and sticker pressing down: scale 1.06 -> 1, fast and firm.

soft.use: UI feedback: buttons, toggles, cards. No overshoot.

stopMotion.use: Per second of movement: 12 held poses. Use steps(n) with n = duration in ms / 83.

onThrees.use: Per second of movement: 8 held poses, rougher. For loops and big hero moves.

draw.use: A hand-drawn line writing itself on in visible chunks.

ui.use: Smooth fallback for interface elements where steps would feel broken.

exit.use: Pieces lifted away: accelerate out, can be stepped (steps(4)).

drop.use: A piece dropped onto the page; lands with a small overshoot.

slap.use: Sticker or ransom letter slapped on in two poses.

tape.use: Tape strip appears by growing along its length (scaleX 0 -> 1) in three poses.

stamp.use: Stamp thumps in: scale 1.06 -> 1 and opacity 0 -> 0.8 in three poses.

scribble.use: Hand-drawn arrow or underline writes itself on (needs pathLength="1").

wobble.use: A resting item nudges back and forth, as if touched. One item at a time.

boil.use: Swap between 2-3 slightly different versions of one hand-drawn line (classic line boil). One mark only.

flutter.use: A loose corner or ticket lifting slightly (skewY 0 -> 2deg -> 0).

durations.$comment: Short and chunky. Rule of thumb for steps: n = duration / 83 ms (12 poses per second).
durations.formula: duration = 200 ms + 0.3 ms per pixel travelled (capped at 900 ms), rounded to a multiple of 83 ms

choreography.settleBeforeText: Headline strips start once the hero is taped down.

loop.endsOn: The finished collage, still, working as an image on its own.

rules: Steps for artwork, springs for interface: art moves in held poses (12 per second); buttons and menus stay smooth.
One thing moves at a time; the stagger is long enough (about 120 ms) to see each piece land.
Pieces land and stay. Only one item may wobble, boil or flutter in a loop.
No smooth floating, no parallax beyond 1% of the artboard, no camera moves, no spinning.
Text strips drop in like paper but the letters never animate individually after landing.
With reduced motion: show the finished collage. Wobble, boil and flutter stop.
